slow_step_reproduction: In [weak convergence and squaring](knowledge/nodes/N-H-boundary.md#weak-convergence-and-squaring), write a_n=<g,e_n>. Orthonormality reduces the finite projection error to ||g||^2-sum|a_n|^2, so its nonnegativity bounds the increasing partial sums and forces a_n to zero. Multiplying by sqrt(pi) gives exactly the test integral for the unnormalized sine sequence.
